# Laposta

Dutch newsletter app (email marketing) that makes it exceptionally easy to send professional newsletters.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/laposta/.

## Actions

- **Create Custom Field**: Create a custom field for a mailing list to define subscriber attributes.
- **Create Mailing List**: Create a new mailing list in Laposta to manage email subscribers.
- **Create Member**: Add a new subscriber relationship to a list with custom fields and tracking info.
- **Create Webhook**: Register a new webhook for list events in Laposta.
- **Delete List**: Permanently remove a mailing list from Laposta.
- **Delete Member**: Permanently remove a member from a list.
- **Get All Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve all campaigns from Laposta account.
- **Get All Fields** (read-only): Retrieve all fields for a specific list in Laposta.
- **Get All Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all mailing lists from your Laposta account.
- **Get All Members** (read-only): Retrieve all members from a specified Laposta mailing list.
- **Get List Details** (read-only): Retrieve specific list details by list_id.
- **Get Member** (read-only): Retrieve specific member details by member_id or email.
- **Get Webhook Details** (read-only): Retrieve specific webhook details by webhook_id.
- **Update Field**: Modify field configuration in a Laposta list.
- **Update Mailing List**: Modify list properties such as name, remarks, or notification emails.
- **Update Member**: Modify member data, status, or custom fields in a Laposta list.
- **Update Webhook**: Modify webhook configuration including URL, event type, or blocked status.
- **Clear All Members From List**: Clear all active members from a list.
- **Delete Field**: Permanently remove a custom field from a mailing list.
- **Delete Webhook**: Permanently remove a webhook.
- **Get All Campaign Reports** (read-only): Retrieve performance metrics for all campaigns.
- **Get All Segments** (read-only): Retrieve all segments from a mailing list.
- **Get All Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all webhooks for a specific list.
- **Get Field Details** (read-only): Retrieve specific field details by field_id.
